note: NGPC recreation area on the south bank of the North Platte River, next to Buffalo Bill Ranch State Historical Park (Scout's Rest). One herringbone row of gravel back-in electric pads near the bank, with primitive sites around the loop; one vault toilet and water. No golf carts or four-wheelers. --Claude
summary: RA park page: 23 RV pads (16 x 30 A, 7 x 50 A), 12 primitive sites, one vault toilet, 40-ft max, 180-day window, phone (308) 535-8035; RA lists 17 electric + 6 Basic (20 ft). Fees re-based 10-15 -> 20-30 (basic sites too short for 23 ft), electric surcharge cleared; booking platform operator -> reserveamerica; count 31 -> 35; 'primitive restrooms' fixed to vault toilet. Pin OK (~130 m S of the pad row). Waterfront riverfront -> riverview lead (only 21/23 within ~50 m, bank two-track between).
flags: PHONE missing: add (308) 535-8035 (ReserveAmerica park page and the NGPC grid row).

WEBSITE: the stored RA link (https://nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/buffalo-bill-ranch-sra/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NE) returns 404; replace it with https://nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NE&parkId=233960.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored riverfront -> riverview): the North Platte here is 80-150 m wide (river, not creek). Measured on imagery from the RA GIS points of the east pad row: site 23 ~31 m from a backwater edge across a sandy landing at the end of the loop road; 21 ~51 m; 19 ~64 m; 17 ~77 m; 15-07 90-110 m. The ground between is open grass-scrub with scattered trees, but a dirt two-track runs along the bank and the loop road passes between site 23 and the water; the west-row pads (10-22) are another 10 m back across the pad road. RA tags no site as on the water. Only one or two pads come near the ~50 m line and the bank track sits between: unsure, so down to riverview.
PIN OK: stored 41.17104,-100.78913 is at the south end of the electric pad row, ~130 m from its centre (41.1722,-100.7893).
No split: one loop, one entrance (from the Scout's Rest Ranch road).

Fees: grid rates, not a quote (RA shows no quotable night through April 2027). The grid's $15 basic rate goes with the 20-ft basic sites; if AWH reads the 12 primitive sites as fitting a 23-ft rig, the base would be $15/$10.
